**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert at preferred level).**

- **Investigation:** Section 10 (Confidentiality) has confidentiality covenants and exclusions but no return-or-destroy obligation. Section 13 (Term) puts the burden on *Client* to arrange a new name server (30 days) and hosting environment (60 days) and confirms Client retains domain/Client Content ownership, but imposes no TrueLink exit duty. Section 14 (Termination) only fixes the service run-off date. Targeted searches for transition/migration/export/data return/deletion returned nothing responsive.
- **Conclusion:** No usable clause exists, and the current position sits close to walk-away territory (no data return obligation at all).
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at Section 14 carrying exactly the six preferred elements — expiry-or-termination trigger, up to six months' assistance, then-current rates, 30-day return, standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion *after* return — with the data scope drawn broadly ("belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client") rather than narrowed to named examples. Fallback (90 days / 30-day export) offered in the comment.
